submitter: travelling-docs thread (bugfix 024 session), 2026-07-21 — bugs_open/024 DEFECT 6, the delivery blocker
rationale:
bugs_open/024: a tool-improver template fix reaches content_components.html_template and is never rendered onto the live page. Five of six defects are fixed and live (v1.0.1140 + migration 180); the request is now correctly formed (proof run 666619d1 carried reason=section_data_resolved, component_id, a component-scoped item_key, status=triaged). But the page STILL did not render, because the proof exposed defect 6, one layer down.

DEFECT 6: create_rerender_items builds the per-page work item_key as page_rerender_<page>_<site> — blind to the render MODE — and inserts ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. page-rerender's check_rerender_mode branches on spec.reason: a reason-bearing item drives a true template re-render (rerender_page_sections, the only writer of page_components.rendered_html); a reason-less item drives assemble-only (rerender_single_page, 'Simple concatenation, no template re-rendering', which re-ships the STORED html). Because both modes share the key, a stale reason-less page_rerender (b5dbd732, born 18:50 from an earlier run) sat OPEN in the backlog; when my reason-bearing needs_rerender ran at 21:45, create_rerender_items tried to insert the SAME key, collided, created ZERO items (items_created:0), and the reason-less item then ran at 22:51 with no reason -> assemble-only -> re-deployed stale HTML and set build_status=deployed. The correct request was produced and silently discarded.

THE FIX (one edit, Go, image-gated): make the item_key carry the render-mode discriminator (the stamped spec.reason, or 'assemble' when none). The two modes then dedup WITHIN themselves (two concurrent site-wide refreshes still collapse to one assemble-only item per page) but can NEVER suppress each other. This is the same collision class as defect 4 (the needs_rerender site-wide key), one layer down.

WHY KEY-SCOPING ALONE IS SUFFICIENT (a correction to this bug file's own candidate-1 warning). The bug file warned that scoping the key is 'not sufficient alone: if the assemble-only item runs LAST it re-deploys stale', and recommended a companion last-writer-wins rule. Reading the code end-to-end shows that fear does not hold for the FINAL state: save_page_sections DELETEs all page_components for the page and re-INSERTs freshly template-rendered sections with build_status='deployed'; and defect 3's fix (isSelfContainedSection) makes a tool section RENDER from its current template rather than escalate. So once the reason-bearing item is un-suppressed it writes fresh rendered_html; a later assemble-only item then reads that fresh HTML and re-ships it. In every ordering the page ends fresh. The only residual is a transient stale deploy if assemble-only happens to run before the section-render — self-corrected minutes later. I am flagging this correction explicitly so the council can refute it if I am wrong; it is the reason this fix is one edit rather than two subsystems.

WHY REASON AND NOT COMPONENT_ID: a section-render re-renders the WHOLE page from templates (it iterates every stored section), and the page_rerender spec carries no component_id — so two section_data_resolved requests for the same page SHOULD dedup to one render. Keying by component_id would over-separate and cause redundant full-page re-renders.

OUT OF SCOPE, FILED SEPARATELY: the general 'assemble-only ships stale' hole — the idea.uk second reproduction, where a hand-edited template plus a reason-less rerender-pages run has NO reason-bearing item at all, so no section-render ever runs and the stale deploy is the final state — is bug 024 candidate 4. Key-scoping cannot fix that (there is only one request, and it is the assemble-only one); it needs the structural 'refuse to assemble-deploy when a referenced template is newer than the stored render' rule, which is a larger change to a fleet-wide path and deserves its own review. This submission does not claim to fix it.

plan.summary: Scope the per-page page_rerender item_key by render mode (spec.reason, or 'assemble' when none) so a reason-less assemble-only request can neither suppress nor be suppressed by a reason-bearing section-render request. One Go edit in create_rerender_items, the sole producer of this key format. Closes bugs_open/024 defect 6 (the delivery blocker). Committed cdd858402, inert until the next chassis image.

edits.rationale: The item_key must discriminate the two render modes, because that is exactly what check_rerender_mode branches on. keyReason mirrors what the spec carries: empty spec.reason (assemble-only) -> 'assemble' token; a stamped reason (section_data_resolved / image_landed / cta_links_stale) -> that reason. Keying both modes on page_rerender_<page>_<site> alone let a stale reason-less item suppress the correct reason-bearing one via ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING and then re-deploy stale HTML. Dedup is preserved within each mode. create_rerender_items is the ONLY producer of this key format (check_misdirected_cta uses a distinct 'misdirected_cta:<page>:<site>' key), and nothing parses the format, so the change is localised and safe.

grounded_in: BEFORE (create_rerender_items_action.go:248): `itemKey := fmt.Sprintf("page_rerender_%s_%s", pageName, siteID)` — inserted with `INSERT INTO site_work_items (...) VALUES (...) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`. Site+page scoped, blind to reason.

check_rerender_mode (LIVE page-rerender agent definition) gates the true re-render on spec.reason: condition `input_data.spec.reason == 'image_landed' OR == 'section_data_resolved' OR == 'cta_links_stale'` -> then_step rerender_sections; else_step render_page (rerender_single_page). rerender_single_page_action.go header: 'Simple concatenation - no template re-rendering'.

save_page_sections_action.go:487 `DELETE FROM page_components WHERE page_id = $1`, then :544 `INSERT INTO page_components (page_id, position, rendered_html, slot_name, component_id, content_data, content_brief, build_status) VALUES (..., 'deployed')` — a section-render fully REPLACES the page's rendered_html with fresh template output. This is why an assemble-only run AFTER a section-render reads fresh HTML, not stale.

rerender_page_sections_action.go:199 `if comp, ok := schemas[s.slotName]; ok && isSelfContainedSection(comp) { ... continue }` — a self-contained tool section is NOT escalated (defect 3 fix); at :339 `rendered := RenderTemplate(htmlTemplate, rc, logger)` renders it from comp.Raw['html_template'] (the current template) into the metadata save_page_sections ingests.

Defect-6 timeline from claimed_at/completed_at (NOT updated_at, which is unmaintained — bugs_open/035): reason-less page_rerender b5dbd732 created 2026-07-20 18:50; reason-bearing needs_rerender 666619d1 ran 21:45-21:46 and its create_rerender_items reported items_created:0 (collision); b5dbd732 ran 22:51-22:53 with no reason -> assemble-only -> stale re-deploy.

LIVE 2026-07-21 (gamesdesign.co.uk, page_component 45229c85, component 3862f72f): template .ltb-row-grid rule is `display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; ... min-width: 0; max-width: 100%`; rendered_html .ltb-row-grid rule is still `display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr auto`; length(rendered_html)=9901 = the v1 born length. The page is genuinely still stale — the fix reached the template (component_versions v6, 2026-07-20 20:52) and never the render.

Sole-producer check: `grep page_rerender platform/**/*.go` — only create_rerender_items builds the `page_rerender_<page>_<site>` format; check_misdirected_cta.go:326 uses `misdirected_cta:%s:%s`; diagnose_silent_check_action.go matches a different colon-delimited key. Nothing parses the underscore format.
plan.risks: 1) Rollout divergence: existing OPEN reason-less page_rerender items in the fleet carry the old key (no suffix); new reason-less items get '_assemble'. During the window a page could get one old-key and one new-key assemble-only item — both produce identical output, harmless, self-clears as old items complete. 2) Slight churn: a site-wide refresh (reason-less) coinciding with a component regen (reason-bearing) for the same page now runs BOTH a section-render and an assemble-only for that page instead of one. Final state correct; one extra deploy. 3) The correction in the rationale (key-scoping alone delivers) is the load-bearing claim — if save_page_sections did NOT delete+reinsert, or a tool section escalated, a companion last-writer-wins rule would be required. Both are verified against current code, but this is the thing to check. 4) Does NOT fix the general assemble-ships-stale hole (idea.uk reproduction) — that is candidate 4, out of scope by design.
